response.overview: Salvador Dextre has been blind since the age of 20, having lost his sight in an accident. His drive, strength, fighting spirit, and determination to move forward—despite his condition—did not stop him from achieving his goals. As the official harpist for Dina Páucar, a "Marca Perú" ambassador, and a collaborator with various national folk artists—taking his music to every corner of the country—he stands as an example of resilience, perseverance, and the conviction to achieve one's dreams and goals, regardless of the obstacles encountered.
response.title: Salvador, el Dextre del arpa
